metadata.title: A quadratic family of integral two-torsion classes in a Huneke-Wiegand Koszul presentation
metadata.description:
We study an explicit integral Koszul presentation arising in the graded-syzygy analysis of a previously constructed Huneke-Wiegand family. For every integer p>=8, its cokernel contains a direct summand isomorphic to (Z/2)^floor(((p-2)^2+3)/12). The classes are indexed by strictly increasing nonnegative triples of sum p-2. Reflection-symmetric interval potentials give explicit original integral sources for twice each class, while relative parity functionals detect them independently.

For a semantic row projection retaining four of six recurring row types, we prove a new uniform constructive identity: two endpoint triangle rows vanish for every p>=8, each by a single explicitly labelled source column of coefficient height one. The proof classifies every face before contraction. A locked p=11 frozen-carrier comparison and independent exact sweeps through p=300 validate the implementation without replacing the symbolic proof.

A tracked four-row vector is integrally congruent to one selected triangle class. We also give its full twice-source, two short kernel-domain corrections, and an integral potential basis of rank binomial(p-1,2). The complete cokernel, a matching upper bound, and a uniform identification with earlier isolated subpresentations remain unresolved.

The family-to-presentation identification is an imported premise. Son Pham retains priority for the original public Huneke-Wiegand counterexample. Source code, computation records and archived sources: https://github.com/fsantibanezleal/CAOS_RESEARCH .
metadata.version_notes: Correction: Theorem 9.1 (support-one endpoint sources) displayed Pi_58 M_p s_(p,r) = -x_(0,r,p-2-r), which holds for even p only in the paper's sign convention; the identity is (-1)^(p+1) x_(0,r,p-2-r), minus the unsigned K row. The vanishing of the two endpoint rows and every other result are unchanged. Found by an independent audit (2026-11-11).
